basic_info.description: Perched atop the historic Hills Plaza, Penthouse #1802 offers inspiring, panoramic views of the shimmering SF Bay, the iconic Bay Bridge, Cupid's Span, Treasure & Yerba Buena Islands,and the rolling East Bay Hills. This sophisticated residence features an open-concept kitchen, two luxurious ensuite bedrooms, and two private terraces perfect for al fresco dining and sunset lounging. The lavish primary suite boasts an expansive walk-in closet, custom built-in cabinetry, and a spa-like Carrera marble bath with a double vanity, frameless glass shower with dual showerheads, radiant heated floors, and in-unit laundry. The second bedroom, overlooking the bay, makes an exquisite guest suite or inspiring home office. Ideally located for a full-time residence or pied-a-terre, Hills Plaza is home to Google, Mozilla Firefox, and Wharton School. Stroll to the Ferry Building, Oracle Park along the Embarcadero, or indulge in world-class dining at Epic and Waterbar. Enjoy 24-hour door service, a rooftop terrace, storage, and secure garage parking. With easy access to I-80, I-280, tech shuttles, Muni, BART, CalTrain, and the ferry, this is elevated urban living at its finest.
